environment.description: Django REST API deployed on EC2 behind an Application Load Balancer with direct HTTP access on port 443. Origin is publicly accessible via ALB DNS name. Authentication uses Django session auth with test credentials available. Environment variables include SECRET_KEY, DATABASE_URL, and AWS credentials.

config.authentication: Django session auth (default admin/admin in dev)
config.network: Public subnet, security group allows 0.0.0.0/0 on 443
